notes.title: [WIP BETA] Cyber Skirmish Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43167624/46f98f58b234e840049e429400497cb551641020.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43167624/062805e5973c18d7540bd79ba7e58a736b4ac0dc.png[/img][/url]

Update Announcement for Cyber Skirmish

Hello Cyber Skirmish Players,  

We are excited to announce a new update for Cyber Skirmish! In this version, we have introduced Local Multiplayer (LAN Only), allowing you to battle against your friends on the same network. Gather your team, connect to the same Wi-Fi, and enjoy intense skirmishes in this new multiplayer experience!  

Please Note:
This multiplayer version is currently in the testing phase, so you may encounter some bugs or connectivity issues. We are actively working to improve the stability and performance of the multiplayer mode, and your feedback will be crucial in helping us do so.  

We also want to apologize for the lack of updates recently. We understand that our community has been eagerly waiting for new features, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. We are committed to bringing you more exciting content and improvements in the future.  

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. We look forward to hearing your feedback on the new LAN multiplayer mode!  

See you on the battlefield,  
WePanMi Interactive

notes.title: Dev Diary - Cyber Skirmish Beta update!
notes.content:
Cyber Skirmish beta version is here!
The new Cyber Skirmish Update includes:
-New main menu
*Now, main menu background is a space base.
*Main menu buttons have new colors.

-Added a easter egg
*Can you find it?

-Cyber Skirmish is now in beta version.
*The game will be in full version soon.
*In beta version we have plans to add:
+ New player ships
+ New missions 
+ Best score
+ Greater variety of player ships

Thank you for your feedback and support.
-Hubert Mierzbiczak, hmstudios.

notes.title: Dev Diary - Cyber Skirmish Alpha v1.7.1
notes.content:
Update v1.7.1 is here!
The new Cyber ​​Update includes:

- New laser VFX and texture.
* Now Laser looks more 3D.
* Laser light effect added.

- Back Engine VFX
* Now Main Back Engine looks better.

- Bug fixes
* Fixed bug on DirectX 10 (Game was crashing after selecting new ship)
* Fixed Box Collider On Enemy Special Ship (Now its easier to destroy it)

Thank you for your feedback and support.
-Hubert Mierzbiczak, hmstudios.
